packageRules.description: The DHI .NET SDK and runtime move together: TargetLatestRuntimePatch makes an app need the runtime patch its SDK knows, so an SDK bump without the matching runtime bump leaves the build broken.
A .NET major is due only when the app's upstream retargets, and it then moves with the app's own bump, so it waits for approval on the Dependency Dashboard.
